claim: Foot Locker Europe B.V. (KvK 23067735), the Utrecht entity carrying FL EMEA retail and inventory risk, has filed no company-only annual accounts since FY2020. For FY2021-FY2025 KvK holds only 'Groepsjaarrekening ingevolge 408' (the parent group's consolidated accounts), while even FL's dormant Dutch shells keep filing their own accounts. That implies the entity relies on the art. 2:403 BW exemption, so its EMEA P&L is not public after FY2020. The 403 statement itself (and any 404 withdrawal) is only visible in the paid 'Overzicht deponeringen' (EUR 2.95).
data_point: Own Jaarrekening on file: 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020 only. Groepsjaarrekening ingevolge 408: 2018-2025, with FY2025 already deposited. Deeds: Statutenwijziging 16-01-2023 and 29-03-2024 (seat move Vianen to Utrecht 26-03-2024 per FL Germany notes); nothing deposited after the 2025-09-08 close. Each document costs from EUR 3.90.
source_name: KvK Handelsregister product page (Jaarrekeningen / Gedeponeerde documenten lists, free view)
original_quote: 2025 - Groepsjaarrekening ingevolge 408 ... 2021 - Groepsjaarrekening ingevolge 408 / 2020 - Jaarrekening / 2020 - Groepsjaarrekening ingevolge 408 / 2019 - Jaarrekening
english_translation: 2025 - Group annual accounts pursuant to art. 408 ... 2021 - group accounts (408) / 2020 - Annual accounts / 2020 - group accounts (408) / 2019 - Annual accounts
verifier_note: Filing list read directly on kvk.nl on 2026-10-07. The 403 conclusion is an inference: no own accounts for FY2021-25 at a large BV is only lawful under 403. Not bought; the 403 deposit date is unverified.

claim: Foot Locker Netherlands B.V. (NL store op-co, KvK 23063181) and Foot Locker Europe.com B.V. (EU e-commerce entity, KvK 30181126) have no FY2024 accounts at KvK, about 9 months after the latest statutory deadline (31-12-2025 for a calendar-2024 BV). The last accounts on file are FY2023. Europe.com had a KvK 'new deposit' flag on 13-08-2026, but no new jaarrekening appeared, so that deposit was something else (possibly a 403 statement). The dormant FL Norway B.V. has already filed FY2025, so the gap is specific to these two entities.
data_point: FL Netherlands own accounts 2017-2023; Europe.com 2016-2023; neither has 408 group accounts. Company.info current ratio: NL 1.37, Europe.com 1.43. Control: FL Norway B.V. has filed 2018-2025.
source_name: KvK Handelsregister product pages; Company.info (KvK-sourced news)

english_translation: 2023 - Annual accounts / 2022 - Annual accounts ...; '13-08-2026 Organisation may have new deposits (e.g. annual report)'

claim: Foot Locker Dutch Holdings B.V. (KvK 84791446), the holdco that absorbed the Spanish FL Europe Holdings SLU, amended its articles on 5-Dec-2025 (the first post-close deed in the Dutch FL chain). KvK then recorded it as 'gefuseerd en/of gesplitst' (merged and/or demerged) on 6-Oct-2026, which looks like the Dutch-side registration of the cross-border merger, about 5 weeks after the Spanish dissolution of 28-08-2026. The merger deed and the toelichting are not yet in the free deposited-documents list.
data_point: Deeds: Akte van oprichting 16-12-2021; Statutenwijziging 05-01-2022 (x2), 24-03-2023, 26-04-2024, 05-12-2025. Own accounts 2022-2024; 408 group accounts 2021-2025. Amperse 'Bestuurder B' from 2026; non-mailing indicator on; 'concernrelaties' product not available.
source_name: KvK Handelsregister product page; Company.info (source KVK 06-10-2026)
original_quote: Statutenwijziging — Ingediend op: 5 december 2025 ; '06-10-2026 Organisatie is gefuseerd en/of gesplitst'
english_translation: Amendment of articles — filed 5 December 2025; '06-10-2026 Organisation has merged and/or demerged'
verifier_note: Both items read at source on 2026-10-07. Linking the 06-10-2026 event to the Spanish merger is an inference. The content of the Dec-2025 articles amendment is unknown (EUR 3.90). Structure simplification is equally consistent with a tax/admin cleanup.

claim: FL's country distributors are net lenders into the Foot Locker Europe B.V. cash pool. FL Germany KG's receivables from affiliates (incl. FL Europe B.V.) rose to EUR44.9M at end-2024 from EUR36.4M, with affiliate interest income up to EUR1.38M from EUR0.53M, and the KG is financed only by shareholder loans and the FL Europe B.V. cash pool. The UK group swung from owing group companies GBP7.66M to being owed GBP4.21M net of GBP0.33M. Company.info shows FL Europe B.V.'s current ratio at 0.43 (year not shown). INFERENCE: the Dutch entity funds the loss-making EMEA risk with its subsidiaries' cash.
data_point: DE FY2024: Forderungen gegen verbundene Unternehmen EUR44,887,405 (2023: 36,406,768); Zinsertraege verbundene EUR1,382,085 (526,360); equity ratio ~0.2%. UK CY2024: group receivable GBP4,207k (150k), group payable GBP332k (7,659k). FL Europe B.V. currentRatio 0.43.
source_name: FL Germany GmbH & Co. KG Jahresabschluss 2024; Foot Locker UK Ltd annual report CY2024 (notes 11-12); Company.info

english_translation: The company is financed exclusively through loans from its shareholder and through the intra-group cash pooling with Foot Locker Europe B.V., Utrecht (until 26 March 2024: Vianen)

claim: Cheapest public route to FL Europe B.V.'s own numbers: its sole shareholder FLE Holdings Cooperatief U.A. (KvK 30184448) files company-only accounts through FY2024 and uses the 408 exemption from consolidating. Its FY2024 jaarrekening (EUR 3.90 at KvK) should therefore carry the FL Europe B.V. participation at net asset value and the participation result. This was not bought.
data_point: FLE Holdings Coop: own Jaarrekening 2016-2024 and 408 group accounts 2016-2025; Statutenwijziging 03-04-2024; management change 04-08-2026; Company.info shows FLE Holdings as sole shareholder of FL Europe B.V. and FLE Logistics B.V.
